species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 69°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 36–50 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
South wind at 17 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
